name: sos-gw-node-ts
description: SOSCHAIN Gateway service extending GW CORE for secure emergency data interoperability

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('ERROR: sos-gw-node-ts is a deployable service and must never be published to npm'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:swagger && tsc && node scripts/patch-esm-imports.mjs
scripts.build:swagger: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS='{"module":"NodeNext","moduleResolution":"NodeNext","allowImportingTsExtensions":true}' node --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node scripts/generate-swagger-spec.mts && node scripts/generate-openapi-profiles.mjs && node --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node scripts/generate-core-flow-examples.mjs
scripts.demo:bootstrap-single-tenant: if [ -f .env.local-demo ]; then npx dotenv -e .env.local-demo -- ./scripts/bootstrap-single-tenant.sh; else echo 'ERROR: missing .env.local-demo'; exit 1; fi
scripts.api:alice: if [ -f .env.alice ]; then npm run build:swagger && npx dotenv -e .env.alice -- nodemon --legacy-watch --watch 'src/**/*.ts' --watch 'swagger.config.cjs' --exec 'TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS={\"module\":\"NodeNext\",\"moduleResolution\":\"NodeNext\",\"allowImportingTsExtensions\":true} node --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node src/main.ts'; else echo 'ERROR: missing .env.alice'; exit 1; fi
scripts.api:bob: if [ -f .env.bob ]; then npm run build:swagger && npx dotenv -e .env.bob -- nodemon --legacy-watch --watch 'src/**/*.ts' --watch 'swagger.config.cjs' --exec 'TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS={\"module\":\"NodeNext\",\"moduleResolution\":\"NodeNext\",\"allowImportingTsExtensions\":true} node --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node src/main.ts'; else echo 'ERROR: missing .env.bob'; exit 1; fi
scripts.demo:communication-medications-ips: if [ -f .env.local-demo ]; then npx dotenv -e .env.local-demo -- ./scripts/demo-communication-medications-ips.sh; else ./scripts/demo-communication-medications-ips.sh; fi
scripts.dev: npm run build:swagger && nodemon --legacy-watch --watch 'src/**/*.ts' --watch 'swagger.config.cjs' --exec 'TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS={\"module\":\"NodeNext\",\"moduleResolution\":\"NodeNext\",\"allowImportingTsExtensions\":true} DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local-demo node --import dotenv/config --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node src/main.ts'
scripts.api:local-demo: npm run build:swagger && npx dotenv -e .env.local-demo -- nodemon --legacy-watch --watch 'src/**/*.ts' --watch 'swagger.config.cjs' --exec 'TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS={\"module\":\"NodeNext\",\"moduleResolution\":\"NodeNext\",\"allowImportingTsExtensions\":true} node --loader ts-node/esm --experimental-specifier-resolution=node src/main.ts'
